answer:
There appears to be **no currently standing wooden lattice tower** in the world today.

The tallest wooden lattice tower in history was the **Mühlacker radio tower** (also known as the Mühlecker radio tower) in Germany. It was completed in **1934** and reached a height of 190 meters (620 feet). Unfortunately, this landmark was **demolished in 1945**.

Historical records indicate that most wooden lattice towers were constructed during the late 19th and early 20th centuries but have since been demolished or destroyed, leaving few or no examples standing today.
